steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The battle was not over. The Underground Puppets grew stronger with each passing moment, until every last HUSH unit was worn down and destroyed.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Their combat pattern just makes no sense. And what's even stranger, they didn't retreat after winning, only to be left scrapped here...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Those Underground bastards can't possibly be kind enough to leave us clues, can they?

You examine the enemy remains carefully. They bear no discernible differences from the Puppets you have encountered previously. And given how severely they are damaged, these alone couldn't possibly have decimated Paradeisos's elite HUSH units.
But there's something else that concerns you even more...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is not the Underground's M.O.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They prefer working from the shadows, inciting chaos and letting others do the dirty work. Even during the last election, they operated covertly through the dark web, taking extensive measures to cover their tracks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But this time, they chose to make such an entrance, right at this crucial moment...
Is this a deliberate provocation? A smokescreen? Or did something go wrong with their plans?

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The feeds were shut down, and the HUSH units were preset to offline mode—that explains their delayed activation. They couldn't arrive at the scene immediately, nor could they receive precise commands from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: It was only Prime Minister Stewart himself who had the access to it, and it was not the first time he abused it like this.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The election wasn't looking good for him—his chances of re-election were slim. These concerns were likely a hot topic during the meeting with his cabinet.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: And as always, their conversation would delve into some sensitive subjects. To keep things under wraps, he had to find a workaround off the record and stop HUSH from syncing data back to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: We're currently keeping tabs on everyone on our radar—suspected Underground spies, informants, gangs, and potential future targets.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Any progress?

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: None of them have made any moves. A thorough investigation will take about a week or two.
You furrow your brow in concern.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Once the new mine is up and running, it will surely bring us a better future. This election's bound to bring changes to many of us.
This election is laden with high hopes, as people expect it to pave the way for a better city—thus, it's no surprise that the Underground seeks to meddle and disrupt the proceedings.
However, their methods this time are strikingly uncharacteristic of them.

Judging from their past actions—the chaos in Syndicate, the Ambrosia incident in Eastside, the Belphegor Art Museum, and the Gray Mirror—it's evident that the Underground excels at using others as pawns and inciting the masses behind the scenes.

However, things are different this time—the Underground resorted to brutal violence using puppets instead of powerful Sinners, yet so far, they have made no attempt to sway public opinion, leaving you to feed the people flimsy excuses.
So, this attack wasn't intended to sow public panic. Instead of derailing the election, the enemy wants you to cover up the truth and ensure the election proceeds as planned. Which means...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is probably just the beginning.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They want the election to proceed as scheduled, so they're probably planning something even bigger.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Should we consider postponing the election?

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Even with the information blackout, the deaths of the cabinet members have caused quite a stir. I agree that this is only the start.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: But the election must proceed as scheduled, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't get it. The entire city is fired up about this election. If the Underground were to hit the event site, the casualties would be catastrophic.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Now it's up to us. We have one month to investigate the truth and eliminate all threats.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is FAC also fine with this?
The soldier remains oddly silent. You see him clutch his weapon before eventually loosening his grip.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: FAC has no authority to interfere with the election. We have to follow our orders.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: We will fortify our patrols and defenses, doing everything we can to ensure civilian safety.
You try to ask more questions, but the agent presses his hand against your shoulder.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: I know you have many concerns about the election, but—

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: This case goes beyond just a Mania attack. Everything that has happened here is far more complex than anything you've faced before.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The impact of the cabinet reshuffle is still within our control, but it cannot escalate further. Too many eyes are watching—the election has to proceed.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The 9th Agency will keep a close eye on suspicious individuals. We'll power through it.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Find the truth.
With a smile, he relaxes his grip and gives your shoulder a pat.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Someone just requested a meeting with you. She claims to have some leads.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: I believe it's someone you know.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The Municipal Affairs Commissioner and one of the Election candidates, <color=#fb9259>Bernadette Cavendish</color>.
